title: planAudit
responsibility: Reports missing proposal sections, acceptance items, measurement plans and request overlap using explicit structural heuristics.

inputs.name: planAudit.proposal
inputs.description: The Markdown proposal inspected for recognized section headings, acceptance bullets, unfinished placeholders, performance measurements, and word overlap with the goal. Section checks require at least 12 trimmed body characters; these structural heuristics do not establish semantic fulfillment.
examples:
# Overview
Build a reporting dashboard for uploaded reports and explain its user-facing scope.
## Acceptance
- Users can filter reports by date and status.
- The dashboard shows the matching report count.
## Dependencies
Use the existing report API and authenticated user session.
## Verification
Verify filters, empty states, and report counts with representative seeded records.
## Performance
Measure a representative workload of 500 reports, recording response latency and peak memory usage.

inputs.name: planAudit.goal
inputs.description: The stated task request used by the plan.request word-overlap heuristic. It must be nonempty; unless no relevant words remain after filtering, at least one remaining word must appear in the proposal, which is not proof of semantic fulfillment.
examples: Build a reporting dashboard for uploaded reports

outputs.name: planAudit
outputs.description: Nine structural TaskCheck records covering the five recognized sections, acceptance bullets, placeholders, performance method, and request overlap. Passing indicates only the implemented heuristic checks and does not prove semantic fulfillment.

examples.detail: Provide a substantive overview section, including an explicit explanation when none applies.
Provide a substantive acceptance section, including an explicit explanation when none applies.
Provide a substantive dependencies section, including an explicit explanation when none applies.
Provide a substantive verification section, including an explicit explanation when none applies.
Provide a substantive performance section, including an explicit explanation when none applies.
Replace unfinished template content before completing the plan.
Name representative workloads, latency and memory measurements; do not invent runtime results for planned code.
The proposal must address the stated request; this word-overlap heuristic still needs human review.
